description: Audit a product homepage before launching it: HTTPS, noindex, title and meta description, og:image (fetched to confirm it loads), X card, favicon, canonical, mobile viewport, h1, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap, parked or 404 pages, response time, and whether the page is empty without JavaScript. Returns a 0-100 score, a verdict and a fix for every problem. Reads the static HTML the way directory scrapers and link-preview bots do.
